review_scope: Visible contact-key compatibility only; not a six-frame gait, game integration, or actor approval.
opposite_physical_leg_identity: UNRESOLVED_FROM_ISOLATED_OCCLUDED_KEYS; no anatomical ownership labels assigned.

evidence.heading: Both keys face screen RIGHT/E; toe boxes and pale face agree with the same elevated side camera.
evidence.front_contact: The screen-right boot extends in front of the pelvis; its heel is lower than its lifted toe. Its shin has one continuous knee-to-ankle contour, not a second boot glued to one leg.
evidence.rear_contact: The screen-left rear boot remains beneath the rear skirt, pointing right; its heel is raised relative to its toe/support end. There is a coherent front-heel/rear-toe contact arrangement.
evidence.pair_difference: The new front shin/boot and trailing boot have very similar outlines and depth presentation to contact0, with modest stride/ankle changes. This establishes similar contact projection, not the anatomical identity of either hidden hip connection.
evidence.depth_evidence_limit: Neither thigh root is visible through the original long skirt, and both greaves share black/gold equipment. No uniquely identified shin mark or visible hip-to-knee chain proves that the same physical leg must remain in front.

full_cycle_release_conditions: Author and inspect all six chronological poses, including both different passing/support exchanges.
Check continuous knee/ankle/boot trajectories into and out of each contact, and the final-to-first seam; reject a repeated single-leg step, joint teleport, double limb, or stride reversal if visible.
Do not claim the new key is a proven anatomical LEFT/RIGHT contact solely from its prompt or from concealed thigh labels.
Maintain the original long skirt, face/camera, paired armor and weapon-hand occlusion; do not expose or shorten the skirt to manufacture ownership evidence.
Validate actual compiled playback, world-foot/root alignment, proportions and cadence before integration approval.
quality_note: Higher native source resolution alone is not a physical model/proportion defect. Contact-compatible keys do not establish a completed opposing-leg cycle.
